newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks maintain ground in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks maintain ground in dull trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were holding firm in dull early Tuesday trade as a few local investors took positions ahead of price rises expected in early 1997, brokers said.
The all share index was 0.3 points higher at 602.9 at mid-morning on turnover of 4.8 million rupees.
"Overall, there seems to be nothing negative to bring down the index," said Prasanna Chandrasekera, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
The main trades in the morning were 50,000 Grain Elevators at 13.75 rupees and 125,000 Sampath Bank at 46, brokers said.
